Holvi connects business accounts to ChtGPT and Claude
summary: Holvi, the digital finance platform for the self-employed and small businesses, is bringing AI agents into financial management. The company has built its own MCP server, which lets compatible AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude access Holvi data with the customer’s consent.
content: Digital finance platform Holvi is integrating AI agents into financial management by connecting its business accounts to popular AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Using a custom Model Context Protocol server, Holvi allows compatible AI assistants to securely access customer financial data with their explicit consent, bridging the gap between business banking and artificial intelligence for self-employed users and small businesses.
content_ta: சுயதொழில் செய்பவர்கள் மற்றும் சிறு வணிகர்களுக்கான டிஜிட்டல் நிதி தளமான Holvi, தனது வணிக கணக்குகளை ChatGPT மற்றும் Claude போன்ற AI கருவிகளுடன் இணைத்து நிதி மேலாண்மையில் AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தை புகுத்துகிறது. வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் அனுமதியுடன், அவர்களின் நிதி தரவுகளை AI கருவிகள் அணுகுவதற்கு ஏதுவாக Holvi தனது சொந்த MCP சேவையகத்தை உருவாக்கியுள்ளது.

title: Visa brings contactless payments to the DRC
summary: Visa today announced the launch of Tap to Pay on Visa Pay in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), enabling eligible users to make secure contactless payments by tapping their NFC-enabled Android smartphones wherever Visa contactless payments are accepted.
content: Visa has launched its Tap to Pay service in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The new offering allows eligible users to make secure contactless payments by tapping their NFC-enabled Android smartphones at any location that accepts Visa contactless payments.
content_ta: Democratic Republic of Congo நாட்டில் Tap to Pay சேவையை Visa அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய சேவையின் மூலம், தகுதியுள்ள பயனர்கள் தங்கள் NFC-இயக்கப்பட்ட Android smartphones-களைப் பயன்படுத்தி பாதுகாப்பான contactless payments செய்ய முடியும்.

summary:
UAE fintech Ziina launches Split Bill, letting users divide group expenses, automate payment reminders, and track settlements as annual volume tops $2 billion.
The post Ziina Launches Split Bill to Simplify Shared Group Payments appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: UAE fintech company Ziina has launched a new feature called Split Bill. This tool is designed to simplify shared group payments by allowing users to easily divide group expenses, automate payment reminders, and track settlements. The launch comes as Ziina's annual transaction volume crosses the $2 billion milestone, highlighting significant growth in the region's digital payment sector.

Ziina-வின் ஆண்டு பரிவர்த்தனை அளவு $2 பில்லியனைக் கடந்துள்ள நிலையில் இந்த புதிய அம்சம் வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

The post Ransomware Gang Claims Visa and JPMorgan Chase as Victims, Sets 48-Hour Leak Deadline appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A newly emerged ransomware gang named n0n has claimed Visa and JPMorgan Chase as its victims, threatening to leak alleged stolen data within 48 hours unless negotiations occur. Visa stated it is aware of the claims and is currently investigating the incident. The cyber extortion threat has raised concerns regarding the security of major financial institutions.

title: First Internet Bank’s Dave Becker on cleaning up consent orders and putting AI to work on SBA loans
summary:

Becker says many recent orders trace to BSA/AML gaps in fintech partnerships, where community banks assumed the fintech owned the compliance work and examiners … 
Continue reading "First Internet Bank’s Dave Becker on cleaning up consent orders and putting AI to work on SBA loans"
The post First Internet Bank’s Dave Becker on cleaning up consent orders and putting AI to work on SBA loans appeared first on Tearsheet.
content: First Internet Bank CEO Dave Becker recently discussed the challenges of resolving regulatory consent orders and the growing role of artificial intelligence in processing SBA loans. Becker noted that many recent consent orders stem from Bank Secrecy Act and anti-money laundering gaps in fintech partnerships, where community banks mistakenly assumed their partners managed the compliance obligations.

content: Critical infrastructure across the United States has experienced a troubling week of widespread outages.
